_source.description: Geometry Dash hitbox geometry + object classification, extracted from the game by the OpenGD project
_source.rect_semantics: struct Hitbox {h, w, x, y}: rect from (x, y) to (x+w, y+h) in GD units (30 per cell), object-local, y up, origin at the object centre
_source.radius_semantics: circular hitbox radius in GD units, centred on the object
_source.object_type_semantics: 0 solid, 2 hazard, 25 slope, 7 decoration, 21 breakable brick; other values are interactables (pads/rings/portals/collectibles) whose rect is a trigger zone, not static collision
_source.slope_orientations: derived in this repo from the game artwork atlas (alpha IoU over the rect bounds); floor_r/ceil_r are solid on the right, floor_*/ceil_* differ by which edge the triangle is attached to
_source.invisible_blocks: IDs 1886/1887/1888: type says decoration but the texture is emptyFrame and a full hitbox rect exists - treated as solid
